import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.lmplot(
    x='Physical Activity Level', 
    y='Sleep Duration', 
    data=df, 
    hue='BMI Category', 
    height=6, 
    aspect=1.6,
    scatter_kws={'alpha': 0.7},
    line_kws={'lw': 2},
    ci=None
)
plt.xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Duration by BMI Category')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
